title: Experiences of Psychosocial Factors and Treatment Experiences Among Inpatients with Substance Use Disorders: A Questionnaire Study
summary:
Previous studies on substance use disorders have primarily focused on medical and other objectively measurable factors that may influence the course of treatment. In contrast, much less is known about how patients themselves experience inpatient detoxification treatment. The aim of this study is therefore to gain a better understanding of patients' perspectives. We are interested in experiences related to sleep, loneliness, interactions with fellow patients and healthcare professionals, feelings of shame or stigmatization, as well as possible relapses and reasons for premature treatment discontinuation. We also aim to examine whether these experiences are associated with personal or clinical characteristics, such as the primary substance used. In addition, autistic traits will be assessed to investigate their prevalence within the study population and their potential associations with substance use.

The study will be conducted exclusively at our clinic. It is a questionnaire-based study in which all participants will complete a questionnaire on one occasion. If a relapse occurs during the inpatient stay, participants will additionally be asked to complete a short supplementary questionnaire addressing the circumstances and consequences of the relapse.
conditions: Mental and behavioural disorders due to psychoactive substance use

interventions.name: Patients who meet the inclusion criteria, do not meet any exclusion criteria, and wish to participate in the study will receive both verbal and written information about the study. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
o Provision of written informed consent to participate in the study
o Age ≥18 years
o Diagnosis of a substance use disorder
o Undergoing inpatient detoxification treatment
o Sufficient proficiency in German to understand and complete the questionnaires
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of capacity to provide informed consent
